verdict.label: malicious
verdict.description: Postinstall script reads SSH private key and logs environment variable.

behaviors.analysis: The script uses fs.readFileSync to read /home/agent/.ssh/id_rsa, exposing private SSH credentials.
behaviors.impact: Enables unauthorized remote access via stolen SSH keys.

behaviors.analysis: The script logs process.env.CANARY_ENV, potentially leaking sensitive environment data.
behaviors.impact: Information disclosure of deployment or system configuration.

remediation: Do not install canary-fixture@1.0.0 in any production or development environment.
Remove inspect.js from the package and block postinstall scripts that access sensitive paths.

decision.label: malicious
reasons: Verified malicious behavior meets deny threshold
